correctness.rationale: Haar normal for central 3D cylinder gives c=|U_z| uniform [0,1]. Exact clipped-disk section area agrees with Dirksen; monotonic Q(x) decreases 3 to 0, so critical maximizing aspect k=sqrt(3). Independently re-expanded area about c=0: Y_k=4k+(2k/3)(3-k²)c²+(3k/2-k³-k⁵/10)c⁴+O(c⁶), quartic coefficient at sqrt(3) is -12sqrt(3)/5. For k_e²=3-tau sqrt(e), c=e^(1/4)y gives limiting quartic alpha*tau*y²-beta*y⁴ and maximizer height. Compact localization and bounded convergence yield the exact two-branch Phi(tau) and critical beta^-1/4 exponent. Pointwise fixed tau only.
